extensionDescription.message: Bring HKUST(GZ) PDC events and SIS class schedules to Outlook, Google Calendar, Nextcloud, or iCalendar.

settingsHeading.message: A place for campus events and classes.

settingsIntro.message: Sign into PDC or SIS as usual. Add2Calendar appears on supported schedule pages and lets you choose where to save each event.

providerEditorHelp.message: Outlook and Google use their own sign-in pages and event editors. No account setup is needed here. Set reminders in their editors.

nextcloudIntro.message: Save directly to a calendar you own or can edit. Each person can use their own Nextcloud server.

calendarUrlHelp.message: In Nextcloud Calendar, open the ⋯ menu beside your target calendar and copy its private link. Use the link for that calendar, not a public share or the general Calendar page.

separateAppPassword.message: Use a separate app password for Add2Calendar.

savedAppPassword.message: An app password is saved. Leave blank to keep it for this same server and username.

nextcloudPermissionHelp.message: Chrome will ask for access only to the Nextcloud server you enter. The app password is stored locally in this extension, is not synced to your Google account, and is not exposed to PDC or SIS pages.

independentFootnote.message: Independent student tool, not an official HKUST(GZ) application. No analytics or external service. Calendar entries are created only when you choose to add or export them. Later source changes are not synchronized.

chinaTimeHelp.message: All times below are China Standard Time (UTC+08:00).

outlookImportSteps.message: In Outlook: Calendar → Add calendar → Upload from file → choose the downloaded .ics file → select your calendar → Import (or Import and Save).

eventCopyFootnote.message: This adds a copy of the event. Later source changes and cancellations are not synchronized. Check the source schedule for updates.

upcomingHelp.message: Upcoming sessions are selected initially. Uncheck events already in your calendar. All times below are China Standard Time (UTC+08:00).

unavailableEvents.message: Events that could not be included

batchCopyFootnote.message: Imported events are copies. Later source changes are not synchronized. Repeated Outlook or Google imports may create duplicates.

multipleVenues.message: Multiple venues listed for this time

chooseVenueHint.message: Choose one venue or keep them combined.

prepareScheduleFailed.message: Could not prepare the class schedule.

pdcSignIn.message: Sign into PDC, then reload the page to use Add to calendar.

pdcSessionAttention.message: Your PDC session needs attention. Sign in again, then reload the page.

pdcHttpError.message: PDC could not load your enrollments (HTTP $STATUS$). Reload to retry.

pdcLoadError.message: PDC could not load your enrollments. Sign in again or reload to retry.

pdcUnknownFormat.message: PDC returned an unfamiliar enrollment format. The extension may need an update.

pdcIncomplete.message: PDC returned an incomplete enrollment list. Reload to retry.

pdcTooManyPages.message: PDC returned too many enrollment pages. The extension may need an update.

eventNoLongerEnrolled.message: This event is no longer in your enrollments.

reloadPdcExtension.message: Reload PDC after installing or updating the extension.

loadEventFailed.message: Could not load this event. Reload PDC and try again.

noEnrolledEvents.message: No enrolled events are available to add.

tooManyEnrolledEvents.message: There are too many enrolled events for one batch. Use individual event buttons instead.

reloadBatchExtension.message: Reload the extension and PDC to use batch export.

loadEventsFailed.message: Could not load the events. Reload PDC to retry.

batchHint.message: Choose from all enrollments and export them together.

buttonsLoadFailed.message: Calendar buttons could not load. Reload PDC to retry.

accessNotGranted.message: Chrome did not grant access. Save again and allow access to your Nextcloud server.

connectionSaved.message: Connection saved. Your credentials will be checked when you add an event.

connectionForgotten.message: Connection forgotten. You can also revoke its app password in Nextcloud → Settings → Security.

providerNextcloudHelp.message: Adds selected sessions to the calendar in Settings. Identical sessions already added by this extension are skipped.

providerIcsHelp.message: Import this file into Outlook, Apple Calendar, Thunderbird, Nextcloud, or another calendar app.

providerWebHelp.message: Opens a prefilled event. Review it and click Save in your calendar. Set reminders there. For multiple sessions, open each one or import a single .ics file.

outlookMultipleHelp.message: Download the selected sessions together, then import the file once in Outlook.

calendarFilePrepared.message: Calendar file prepared for $COUNT$ session(s). Import it into your calendar to finish. Repeated imports may create duplicates.

openEachSession.message: Use each session’s Open link, or download all sessions as one .ics file.

calendarOpened.message: Opened your calendar. Review the event and save it there. The extension cannot confirm whether you saved it.

connectNextcloudFirst.message: Connect your Nextcloud calendar in Settings first, then return here.

nextcloudAccessMissing.message: Access to your Nextcloud server is missing. Reconnect it in Settings.

retrySkipsAdded.message: You can retry; successfully added sessions will be skipped.

previewExpired.message: This preview has expired. Return to the source page and try again.

reviewSaveReminder.message: Review and save the event in the calendar tab. Reopening a session may create a duplicate.

batchNextcloudHelp.message: Adds the selected sessions directly to your configured calendar. Previously added identical sessions are skipped.

batchOutlookHelp.message: One .ics file for every selected event. In Outlook, import that file once to add the whole batch.

batchGoogleHelp.message: One .ics file for the selected events. Import it once in Google Calendar’s settings.

batchFileHelp.message: One .ics file for all selected sessions, ready to import into your calendar app.

outlookBatchTitle.message: Import this batch once in Outlook

outlookBatchSteps.message: Calendar → Add calendar → Upload from file → choose the downloaded .ics file → select your calendar → Import (or Import and Save). All selected sessions are included in that one import.

googleBatchTitle.message: Import this batch once in Google Calendar

googleBatchSteps.message: Settings → Import & export → choose the downloaded .ics file → select your calendar → Import.

filePrepared.message: File prepared: $EVENTS$ event(s), $SESSIONS$ session(s). Import it into your calendar to finish.

pdcEventsAvailable.message: $COUNT$ enrolled event(s) available across all PDC enrollment pages.

dynamicUpcomingHelp.message: Upcoming sessions are selected initially. Uncheck $ITEMS$ already in your calendar. All times below are China Standard Time (UTC+08:00).

dynamicSourceNote.message: Imported $ITEMS$ are copies. Later $SOURCE$ changes are not synchronized. Repeated Outlook or Google imports may create duplicates.

invalidScheduleDate.message: $SOURCE$ returned an invalid schedule date. Check the source schedule.

missingScheduleTime.message: $SOURCE$ has not supplied a complete start/end time.

missingEventIdentity.message: The event code or title is missing.

noUsableSchedule.message: This $SOURCE$ entry has no usable schedule yet. Try again after the source publishes it.

checkDateRange.message: The event date range needs to be checked in $SOURCE$.

invalidEndTime.message: The end time is not after the start time. Check this schedule in $SOURCE$.

missingWeekdays.message: This event spans several dates without meeting weekdays. Its sessions cannot be inferred safely.

tooManySessions.message: This event has too many sessions to export at once.

noMatchingDates.message: No meeting dates match this event’s schedule.

addedFromDescription.message: Added from $SOURCE$. Check $SOURCE$ for later schedule changes or cancellations.

fullCaldavUrl.message: Enter the full private CalDAV calendar URL.

httpsCalendarUrl.message: Use an HTTPS calendar URL without embedded credentials, query parameters, or fragments.

specificCalendarUrl.message: Copy the private link for a specific Nextcloud calendar (…/remote.php/dav/calendars/user/calendar/).

invalidSisRecord.message: SIS returned an invalid class record.

sisNoSchedule.message: SIS did not provide a class schedule. Reload SIS and try again.

sisNoEnrolled.message: No enrolled SIS classes are available to add.

batchTooLarge.message: This batch contains more than 500 enrolled events. Use individual event buttons instead.

sessionBatchTooLarge.message: This batch contains more than 5,000 sessions. Use individual event buttons instead.

nextcloudCredentials.message: Enter your Nextcloud username and app password.

nextcloudRejected.message: Nextcloud rejected the username or app password. Check Settings.

nextcloudNoWrite.message: This account cannot write to the selected calendar. Check Settings.

nextcloudHttp.message: Nextcloud returned HTTP $STATUS$. Check the calendar URL and try again.

nextcloudUnreachable.message: Could not reach Nextcloud. Check the connection, server permission, and calendar URL.

actionUnavailable.message: This action is not available on the current website.

prepareEventFailed.message: Could not prepare the calendar event.
